turns.response_html: You can donate whole blood every 56 days, or approximately every eight weeks. The entire process, from registration to refreshments, takes about one hour.

turns.prompt_text: are there any blood drives going on
turns.response_html: To find a blood drive, you can use the locator tools on the websites of organizations like the American Red Cross, LifeServe Blood Center, Vitalant, or ImpactLife. You can also search online for "blood donation near me" to find local donation centers and mobile blood drives.

turns.prompt_text: search online for a blood donation center near me
turns.response_html:
Here are a few blood donation centers near Ankeny, Iowa:

  • LifeServe Blood Center (Ankeny Donor Center)
  • BioLife Plasma Services (Ankeny location)
  • American Red Cross (Iowa Region, with a chapter in Des Moines)
  • Mission Cancer + Blood (Ankeny and Des Moines locations)
